alignments.note: The waw takes the connective the ASV wrote for it, the compound *together with* (rule 14), read as one rendering rather than one token (rule 30). Head on *with*, the word carrying the coordination, the degree adverb being what English adds — the reasoning rule 24 uses to head *more than* on *than*.
Attributive article rendered by a relative, which the article takes and heads on (rule 41).

The attributive keeps its own English together with the copula rule 20 supplies. Head corrected from *set* to *apart*: rule 44's subtraction test is decisive, since dropping *apart* leaves *were set*, which carries nothing of `מִבְדָּלָה`'s separation, while dropping *set* leaves the separation standing. *set apart* is a light verb with its complement, read as rule 44 reads `הִכְבִּיד` → *made heavy*, and not as the phrasal particle of *put forth* or *take away*, whose *forth* and *away* alone name nothing. The competing reading heads on *set* as the English lexical verb.
No article morpheme stands on the construct, so the supplied *the* joins this noun's unit (rules 15, 29); head on the noun.
Rectum takes the chain's *of* and heads on the name (rule 19).
`בְּ` to *in*; the ASV spends a separate word on the construct noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 splits the pair.
Construct noun with a supplied *the*, no article morpheme standing in the chain (rules 15, 29).
Rectum takes the *of* with a supplied *the* (rules 19, 29).
Next level of the chain, on the same terms.
Innermost rectum takes its *of* and the name (rule 19).
`כֹּל` to *all*; the ASV writes no *of* between the quantifier and its noun, so rule 19's quantifying-construct sentence has nothing to place.
Waw of the town-list formula rendered *with*, which is the connective the ASV wrote for it (rule 14).
Noun; the suffix's possessive is its own unit under rule 18.

review_notes: Partition verified: s001-s019 and t001-t030 each covered exactly once; no `added` and no `unrepresented` units.
Only the target head of s005 changed; every other unit's edges and heads stand as accepted.

The opening waw takes *together with* whole; the alternative of giving it a bare *with* and leaving *together* `added` was rejected, since rule 30 reads the one-rendering condition as one rendering rather than one token, as rule 40 reads *round about*.
